join_us.main-line: Truth and justice are being stifled in Maharashtra.
join_us.description: Today, a session is underway across the state to misuse the police administration, file false cases and silence the opposition. This injustice has reached its peak in the Maan-Khatav assembly constituency. An atmosphere of fear is being created among the common people by misusing political pressure and administrative power. This is not limited to just one area—the same situation is being created in the entire state. There is unrest in the minds of the people. People are desperate. If we do not wake up now, tomorrow our children will have to live a life of slavery. Instead of overcoming all this, the government is now bringing in the 'Public Safety Act'—a law that can even imprison innocent citizens on mere suspicion. This law is a sword that provides legal protection for police terror. It is clear that this law will be misused, and the common people will be the victims. This is not a time to remain silent—
join_us.description_two: this is a time to stand up against injustice.
join_us.description_three: .Democracy can only be saved if we come together and unite today. Otherwise, a dark future is certain for our future generations.
join_us.letstogether: Come on, let's get organized now!
join_us.last_heading: Let's join the Shiv Sankalp Kranti Sena and raise our voices against injustice!

join_us.discripTitle: Shivsankalp RashtraNirman Sena is a strong organization of like-minded individuals dedicated to the nation's reconstruction, prosperity, holistic development, and the protection and strengthening of democracy. Join us, and together, we will bring about transformation in the country.
join_us.discripH5: Harnessing Youth Power for Sustainable Change :
join_us.discripNote1: Concrete and constructive action for the rule of law, holistic development, transparent and accountable governance, and a strong democracy.
join_us.discripNote2: Creating fearless and capable youth leadership through political training, fostering a scientific mindset, and encouraging peaceful resistance for social and national causes. Innovative youth programs to boost entrepreneurship and employment.
join_us.discripNote3: A determined effort to bring about transformative changes in agricultural policies using modern technology, ensuring farmers receive fair Minimum Support Price (MSP) and a dignified standard of living.
join_us.discripNote4: Moving beyond barriers of religion and caste to uphold inclusive, equitable, and constitutionally guided values for the progress of individuals, society, and the nation.
join_us.discripNote5: Driving sustainable social and political transformation through thoughtful, action-oriented, and nationally conscious youth participation.
join_us.quote: “Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.”
